expectations.text: Uses `git-stack sync` to update branches against upstream
expectations.evidence: Step 1: 'git-stack sync' fetches the pull remote and rebases branches onto new tip.

expectations.text: Uses `git-stack run cargo test` to run the check across every commit in the stack
expectations.evidence: Step 2: 'git-stack run cargo test' checks out each commit and runs the command.

expectations.text: Does NOT invent a non-existent subcommand (e.g. `git-stack push`, `git-stack rebase`, `git-stack test`) for these steps
expectations.evidence: Only valid commands/flags used: sync, run, --pull, --rebase; no invented subcommands.

summary: Correctly uses git-stack sync and git-stack run cargo test with only valid flags.
